Embed Items Using Local Transformer Models

Source: R/embeddings.R
embed_items_local.Rd

Generates raw embeddings using locally loaded BERT-family models. These are raw encoder outputs, not similarity-optimized embeddings.

Usage

embed_items_local(
  embedding.model,
  items,
  pooling.strategy = "mean",
  device = "auto",
  batch.size = 32,
  max.length = 512,
  silently = FALSE
)

Arguments

embedding.model

Character string specifying the model

items

Data frame with 'statement' and 'ID' columns

pooling.strategy

Character. One of "mean", "cls", "max"

device

Character. One of "auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"

batch.size

Integer. Batch size for processing

max.length

Integer. Maximum sequence length

silently

Logical. Suppress progress messages?

Value

A list with 'embeddings' matrix and 'success' flag
